_readme: Evidence-backed waivers for the data-integrity gate. A waiver downgrades a
specific finding from FAIL to WARN — it never deletes it; waived findings
stay visible in every artifact. Every entry must say what was verified and
how. Do NOT add a waiver to make a backtest pass; add it because you
checked the underlying data and documented why the flag is a false alarm

issues.note: Polygon 'META' before 2022-06 is the Roundhill Ball Metaverse ETF (~$16), not Facebook/Meta Platforms — ticker was reassigned and Polygon stitches the wrong security's history. Verified 2026-06-10: Polygon META 2021-11-26 = $16.01 vs Alpaca $330.53; Facebook actually traded ~$330 then. Alpaca side is correct; do NOT use Polygon for META history pre-2022-06.
issues.verified: 2026-06-10, manual cross-check of both vendors against known FB price history

issues.note: AMD +52.3% on 2016-04-22 ($2.62 -> $3.99) is the real market reaction to the China THATIC x86 JV + Q1'16 results announced 2016-04-21 after hours. Raw and adjusted series agree exactly (no adjustment factor shift), confirming it is not a data fault.
